acquisition: MS analysis was performed in the DIA mode.
Precursors were selected for data-independent fragmentation with an isolation window width of 25 m/z in 24 windows ranging from 380 to 980 m/z
labeling: All DIA raw files were processed with Spectronaut version 16 using a library-free approach (directDIA)
quantification: For quantification, Precursor Filtering was set to Identified (Qvalue) and MS2 was chosen as the quantity MS-level.
workflow_hints: Carbamidomethylation was selected as a fixed modification, and methionine oxidation and N-terminal acetylation were selected as variable modifications.

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used a library-free DIA approach (directDIA) for quantification. No specific PTM enrichment was performed; the variable modifications mentioned (oxidation, acetylation) are standard search parameters for global proteomics.

scope: HMC3 cells were seeded (1 × 104 cells/cm2) and left overnight to attach; thereafter, cultures have been treated for 24 h with Dox (0.6 μg/mL), CMC-h-BNs (25 μg/mL), or Dox-CMC-h-BNs (25 μg/mL); untreated cultures have been considered as well, as control. Samples were lysed, reduced, and alkylated in 50 mL of LYSE buffer (Preomics) at 95 °C for 10 min and sonicated with an Ultrasonic Processor UP200 St (Hielscher), 3 cycles of 30 s. 50 mg of lysate samples was digested by adding trypsin and LysC

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomic analysis was performed on lysates of HMC3 microglial cells. While the study also involves cell membrane-coated nanoparticles, the material analyzed by MS for the microglial response was the whole cell lysate of the treated cells.
